process.title: Understand the brief
process.body: A conversation before a viewing. We would rather show you three right homes than thirty plausible ones.

process.title: Open the off-market book
process.body: A meaningful share of what we transact is never advertised. Registered clients see it first.

process.title: Negotiate and close
process.body: Valuation, structuring, conveyancing and handover — coordinated by one named adviser, end to end.

about.title: A small firm, on purpose.
about.lede: Leading Properties was founded on a simple observation: most buyers in this market are shown inventory, not advice. We kept the team small so that the person who takes your first call is the person who hands you the keys.

sections.title: Independent by design
sections.body: We are not tied to a developer or a single tower. That is what lets us tell a client when the right answer is to wait, or to buy somewhere we have nothing listed.

sections.title: Licensed and accountable
sections.body: Registered with the relevant emirate authorities, with every transaction run through formal escrow and conveyancing. Ask us for our permit numbers at any point.

sections.title: Long after handover
sections.body: Snagging, leasing, service-charge disputes, resale — the relationship does not end at the transfer counter. Most of our work comes from people we sold to years ago.

values.title: No inflated valuations
values.body: We price to sell, and we show you the comparables we used.

values.title: No portal-only listings
values.body: If we represent it, you can see it in person this week.

values.title: No handing you around
values.body: One named adviser, from enquiry to handover.

contact.title: Tell us what you are looking for.
contact.lede: The more you tell us, the less of your time we waste. Every enquiry is read by an adviser, not a call centre.
